entities.summary: The rise of the Gediminid dynasty: Gediminas's founding of Vilnius (c. 1323), Algirdas's campaigns reaching Moscow, and the vast expansion eastward into Ruthenian (Slavic) lands. Lithuania as the last pagan state in Europe, resisting the Teutonic Order.
